dialogues.speaker: Late that night
dialogues.text: Rain rattled the windows. David had just put away Ethan’s drawing when the phone rang. Amara’s voice broke through the silence.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Victor took Ethan. The back door is open, and I found a trail of clues—but he’s already had a head start.

dialogues.speaker: Unknown number
dialogues.text: A message appeared on David’s phone: “Look for me if you want. Every minute costs you.” Then the number went dead.

choices.label: Call the police
choices.response: David calls Detective Morris. The police will secure the scene while he follows the evidence Victor left behind.

choices.label: Trace Victor’s signal
choices.response: David asks Amara to trace the message. A weak signal points toward the industrial district—and a device that may still be nearby.

choices.label: Go after Victor alone
choices.response: David pockets the phone and follows the muddy prints himself. Victor knows he is coming; the trail is a trap as much as a clue.

metadata.notes: Opening suspense scene and choice for the first playable investigation.
